newsitem.title: EGYPT: Sudanese opposition say they killed nine soldiers.
newsitem.headline: Sudanese opposition say they killed nine soldiers.

text.p: Sudanese opposition forces said on Friday they killed nine government soldiers and destroyed one vehicle in an operation in the east of the country.
The Sudan Alliance Forces, military wing of the National Democratic Alliance, said they attacked the government troops on Thursday 45 km (28 miles) southwest of Kassala town.

"The operation left nine dead and several wounded in the ranks of the forces of the totalitarian terrorist regime and a vehicle fitted with a Doshka machinegun was totally destroyed," they said in a statement. There were no opposition casualties.
The opposition forces began attacks in eastern Sudan earlier this year, apparently from bases in neighbouring Eritrea.

The Asmara-based National Democratic Alliance is a broad coalition of opposition groups, including the Umma Party and the Democratic Unionists, traditionally Sudan's two biggest parties, and southern rebels of the Sudan People's Liberation Army.
It advocates armed struggle to overthrow Sudanese President Omar Hassan al-Bashir, who took power in 1989 in a military coup against a democratically elected government.
